description: Defines test utilities for QUIC protocol, including a DelegatedPacketWriter class and functions to generate initial packet sequences for testing QUIC connections.

classes.name: DelegatedPacketWriter
classes.description: A QuicPacketWriter implementation that delegates packet sending to a user-provided delegate.

methods.name: GetFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates a sequence of packets representing the first flight of a real HTTP/3 connection for testing.

methods.name: GetAnnotatedFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates annotated packet data including session information for testing.
